widgets.title: Camunda Task Queue Size
nrql: SELECT average(acme_backend.camunda.external_task.in_queue) FROM Metric WHERE clusterName = 'acme-cluster-prod' FACET camunda_instance TIMESERIES

notes: FACET attribute 'camunda_instance' not in label_map; used 'camunda_instance'
assumed gauge 'acme_backend_camunda_external_task_in_queue'; verify metric name/type in Mimir and add to metric_map if wrong
FACET without LIMIT: NR returns the top 10 groups by default, the translated query returns ALL groups — wrap in topk(10, ...) if the cardinality is high

widgets.title: Successful External Tasks

notes: attribute 'success' not in label_map; used 'success' — verify the label exists in your stack
attribute 'camunda_instance' not in label_map; used 'camunda_instance' — verify the label exists in your stack
FACET attribute 'task' not in label_map; used 'task'
assumed counter 'acme_backend_handle_task_with_worker_total'; verify name/type in Mimir (/api/v1/metadata)
unit:short
count() on a Metric counter emitted as the summed increase (event count); NRQL count() strictly counts datapoints — use sum() in NR to compare like for like
